candidate_windows.window_text:
To perform label augmentation we rely on OpenAI API as it gives access to several LLMs of the GPT family. Specifically, we choose the gpt-3.5-turbo model. It is one of the best models provided by the API and it is the base version of the GPT model used by ChatGPT web interface.

For the ZS HTC and the clustering part we follow Bongiovanni et al. (2023) and use as embedder mpnet-all (Reimers and Gurevych, 2019; Song et al., 2020) from HuggingFace Sentence Transformers library. Results are measured in terms of

macro-F1 score. All experiments are performed on a single Tesla T4 GPU $^6$ .
